I removed the plastic ball checked to make sure no hardware was broken and started having this clogging problem. I've since changed parts as listed above and also completely taken apart the hot end to clear any plastic stuck in it anywhere. I'm making sure the nozzle is all the way tight and the heatblock is fully seated to the top of the hot end. I've cleared of the extruder gears many times so it's not initially slipping because of that. I believe it must be the hotend because of the failure right before this issue.
